headline: beats_flat_dca_oos=False — mean OOS vs flat DCA -12.39%, 2 of 3 folds infeasible, despite a strong in-sample curve fit
name: Full 11-indicator floor-diversified (Phase A)
verdict_notes: The full-scope end-to-end recalibration run using ALL 11 currently-wired indicators (per the approved plan), floor=0.1/max=1.0 aggregate reweight, curve search on the reweighted index, and OOS walk-forward validation. Stage 1: all 11 indicators survived period search. Stage 2: coarse+refine+ratio-sensitivity reweight was fully stable, flooring power_law itself at 0.1 while maxing the two derived weekly_monthly confluence indicators at 1.0. Stage 3 found a strong in-sample curve fit (risk_adjusted_return=46.79 vs the published baseline's 41.20 on this same index). Stage 4 failed the OOS gate: another instance of the standing pattern where a diversified/derived-indicator-heavy mix looks excellent in-sample but degrades OOS. settings.json and RESEARCH_STATE.md were left untouched. No day-by-day equity curve exists on disk yet for this trial — the driver script (run_full_recalibration.py) only prints summary stats; a real chart could be generated on request by re-running backtest.run_backtest() with these exact frozen weights/curve params.
